rows.source_statement_math: C⁺(A)=sup_{F∈A⁺,F≠0} [F(0)−A∫_{|t|>1}(F̂(t))₊dt]/∥F∥₁; B=limsup_{x→∞}(π(x+√x)−π(x))/(√x/log x), 1≤B≤36/11. RH ⇒ limsupₙ(pₙ₊₁−pₙ)/(√pₙ log pₙ)≤1/C⁺(B)<21/25.
rows.actual_Lean_contract: For every eligible real even continuous nonzero L1 F and actual Fourier partner G with finite positive exterior leakage and positive denominator D=F(0)−(36/11)J(G), ordinary RH implies every epsilon>0 eventually paperNormalizedGap(n)≤∥F∥₁/D+epsilon.
derivation: The source Fourier convention is exp(−2πixt), matching actual Mathlib Fourier. Exterior is the complement of closed[−1,1], exactly1<|t|.
J≥0 and B≤36/11 imply D_B≥D_36/11>0. Definition(1.3) yields C⁺(B)≥D_B/∥F∥₁≥D_36/11/∥F∥₁; taking reciprocals gives the written source contract.
The zero-based Nat.nthPrime normalization is connected by paperPrime(n+1)=primeAt(n). The paperPrime(0) totalization is harmless: every proof-bearing statement is eventual and the shift uses n+1≥1.
Eligible restricts to finite leakage; an infinite positive leakage cannot yield the required positive finite denominator. This restriction does not create a stronger source claim.

derivation: The same reciprocal witness inequality and nonnegative1+2alpha preserve the source inequality direction.

GoodCoefficient is the source strict positive liminf margin expressed with an explicit positive eventual reserve. Nonemptiness is explicit, matching the source finite-infimum theorem and avoiding Lean empty-sInf conventions.

rows.source_locator: physical PDFp23 Section6 setup/RH/no-primes closed[x,x+c√x log x], p24 Eq(6.10)--(6.11) with λ=.9, p26 Eq(6.16); geometry p19 Eq(5.6)--(5.8)
rows.source_statement_math: No prime in[x,x+c√x log x], RH, x≥4·10¹⁸ and1/2≤c≤1 ⇒ J(F)√a(2πΔ)≤log(1/(2πΔ))+1.16, where F(x)=H(x/λ), H(x)=cos(2πx)/(1−16x²), λ=.9; a e^(−2πΔ)=x and a e^(2πΔ)=x+c√x log x.
rows.actual_Lean_contract: RH ⇒ for L≥44 and c∈[1/2,1], absence of an actual Nat prime in the closed interval[e^L,e^L+c√(e^L)L] gives cmsJ*cmsMainScale(c,L)≤cmsLogScale(c,L)+29/25.
derivation: Put s=2πΔ=(1/2)log(1+cL/e^(L/2)) and a=e^(L+s). Thus √a s=e^((L+s)/2)s=cmsMainScale; log(1/s)=cmsLogScale. The Lean endpoint geometry is exact.
The source λ=.9 gives F(0)=1 and exterior absolute Fourier mass1−sin(9π/20), because the Fourier cosine window is nonnegative on its compact support. The numerator is1−4(1−sin(9π/20))=4sin(9π/20)−3.
The source ∥H∥₁=(1/2)∫₀^π sinc(u)du follows from c₀=(4/π)/(∫₋₁¹sinc(πt)dt) and ∥H∥₁=1/c₀. Hence ∥F∥₁=(9/20)∫₀^πsinc(u)du, exactly the Lean cmsJ denominator.
29/25=1.16 exactly. L≥44 implies e^L>4·10¹⁸, a restriction within the source domain. c remains in the original closed[1/2,1].

hasPrimeClosed uses both weak endpoint inequalities, matching the source contradiction assumption. Strict-open consequences require a separate endpoint shift; this predicate does not silently alter endpoints.
The source H has removable values at±1/4. The Lean source quotient uses the continuous sinc integral instead; no proof-bearing out-of-domain totalized ratio is introduced.
